Steps.Title: Through the Gate
Steps.Text: The ferryman has left you at the Gatehouse. Walk out of it, and the Chronicle opens.
Steps.Done: The gate is behind you. From here on, what you do is written.

Steps.Title: Warm Hands
Steps.Text: Walk the banners to the fire where the Charter was sworn.
Steps.Done: The fire has not gone out in a hundred winters.

Steps.Title: Who Sits the Throne
Steps.Text: Learn who holds the Old Throne, and how a crown is lost.
Steps.Done: Now you know whose seat it is, for now.

Steps.Title: The First Road
Steps.Text: Leave the Hearth by one of its three roads and find a second waystone.
Steps.Done: Two stones known. The realm is larger than one fire.
